home.title: Modern developer tools, one clean workspace.
home.description: DevBoosty brings JSON, HTML, Markdown, image cleanup, code formatting, AI chat, speech, and image generation into a single browser-based dashboard built for daily workflows.
home.featureSearchDesc: Browse by developer discipline, trending status, or newly added tools from one dashboard.
home.featureWorkspaceDesc: Open multiple tools on one screen so formatting, preview, and cleanup can happen together.
home.featureAiDesc: Use LemonfoxAI for chat, transcription, speech synthesis, and prompt-driven image creation.
home.featureBrowserDesc: Most workflows stay local, which keeps the experience fast and privacy-friendly.
home.coreTitle: Core tools developers use every day
home.coreDesc: The required built-ins live here: image cleanup, HTML preview, JSON formatting, regex testing, code formatting, and more.
home.trendingDesc: Fast access to the most-opened utilities across the platform.
home.categoriesDesc: Frontend, backend, performance, security, AI workflows, and more. Every category opens into the same fast tool library.
home.combineDesc: Build an API lab, UI studio, or docs flow by mixing three tools in a single workspace page.
home.combineBullet1: Use quick presets for common workflows

workspace.title: Multi-tool workspace
workspace.description: Run multiple built-in tools side by side for faster repeat workflows and less context switching.

sidebar.tagline: Built-in developer workflows, ready without setup.
sidebar.description: Search, filter, and combine tools directly in the browser with no signup wall in front of the workflow.

toolsPage.title: Explore the full all-in-one tool platform.
toolsPage.description: Search across built-in developer tools, filter by workspace category, and jump between trending or newly added utilities without leaving the dashboard.
toolsPage.searchPlaceholder: Search JSON, markdown, image, regex, palette...
toolsPage.allToolsTitle: Search, scan, and launch any built-in tool from a single browser-based library.
toolsPage.emptyDesc: Try a broader search or switch back to all categories.

toolPage.whyDesc: This workspace keeps the interaction lightweight and private. The tool runs in the browser, keeps the workflow immediate, and sits next to related actions so repeat visits are quicker.
toolPage.privacyDesc: Input stays in the browser for fast, low-friction use.
toolPage.repeatDesc: Related tools and FAQs sit next to the working area.
toolPage.readyDesc: No account wall between the user and the output.

blogPage.title: Guides connected to the tools people actually use.
blogPage.description: The blog sits inside the same workspace as the tools, so explainers, walkthroughs, and utility pages stay tied together instead of living in separate silos.

favoritesPage.title: Your favorite tools, kept close.
favoritesPage.description: Save the utilities you return to most. This turns repeated formatting, conversion, and quick checks into a much shorter path.
favoritesPage.emptyDesc: Open any tool and tap the save control to keep it here for faster repeat visits.

notFound.title: This route is outside the dashboard map.
notFound.description: The page you asked for does not exist, but the workspace still has a full set of tools ready to use.
